Presentation.title: Who we are
Presentation.intro: REAGE — the Network of Algerian executives and entrepreneurs in Europe — is a non-profit association connecting the Algerian diaspora in Europe with Algeria, around economy, entrepreneurship and training.
Presentation.mission2: Promote the community of executives and entrepreneurs internationally.
Presentation.mission3: Mobilise economic players for the benefit of Algeria.
Presentation.visionBody: Strengthening economic ties between Algeria and Europe through innovative, lasting partnerships: exchange of expertise, cross-investment and know-how transfer across the Mediterranean — with no partisan affiliation.
Presentation.historyBody: Born of initiatives launched in the mid-1990s by Algerian and Franco-Algerian professionals, the association was officially founded on 1 February 2006, following a decision taken at an economic conference on 14 June 2005 at ESCP.
Presentation.governanceBody: REAGE is a non-profit association under the French law of 1901. President: Fetah Ouazzani.

Formation.title: Training
Formation.intro: Flexible, online training to build skills and encourage entrepreneurship, around three pillars: upskilling, entrepreneurship support and personalised mentoring.
Formation.p1Body: Gain confidence and impact when speaking, and reveal your presentation potential.
Formation.p2Body: From strategy to organisation: understand and access consulting careers.
Formation.p3Body: The necessary response to the new business environment.

Legal.privacyIntro: The REAGE association attaches great importance to protecting your personal data and is committed to processing it in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data-protection law.
